abstract: Supply uncertainty, characterized by stochastic lead times and random supply quantities, has attracted increasing attention from academia, industries, and governments, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. In this paper, we consider the problem of managing lost-sales inventory systems with general supply uncertainty: stochastic lead times and random supplies. Unlike the previous studies, we assume the decision maker has no prior information on the stochastic demand and supply. We propose the first provably effective learning algorithm for inventory management problems with censored demand and supply data under general supply uncertainty. Then, we establish a cumulative regret of [Formula: see text] for this learning algorithm compared with the best constant-order policy, where [Formula: see text] is the upper bound of the random part, and L is the deterministic part of the stochastic lead times. We also conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our approach lies in developing a new framework for transformed convexity. Furthermore, we address the unique challenges of our problem through new techniques, for example, estimating the long-run cost by establishing coupling and concentration results utilizing the system structures. These techniques are also of independent interest. Beyond our problem, our framework provides broad implications for other operations management (OM) problems exhibiting transformed convexity. title: Impact of Social Networks on Farmers' Adoption of Smartphones: Evidence From India

title_primary: 社交网络对印度农民智能手机采纳的影响：来自印度的证据

authors: Sai Shiva Jayanth Reddy, Sthanu R. Nair
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Empirical research on agricultural technology adoption has largely focused on farmer and farm level attributes, giving limited attention to the social context in which adoption decisions are embedded. This study addresses this gap by examining how village‐level social networks shape smartphone adoption among farmers in Andhra Pradesh, India. Using primary survey data and network measures constructed from farmers' reported connections, we characterize each farmer's position via average network effect (ANE) and degree centrality (DC). We estimate adoption using an instrumental variable (IV) probit model to address the endogeneity of peer adoption. Contrary to findings from studies of other agricultural technologies, higher smartphone adoption among a farmer's network connections reduces farmer's own likelihood of adoption, consistent with information spillovers that reduce the private need to adopt when peers already have. Farmers who are more central within their network, however, are significantly more likely to adopt, reflecting the greater communication demands placed on well‐connected individuals. Age, social status (caste group), household size, and land ownership are also significant correlates of adoption. The findings suggest that agricultural extension programs can improve cost‐effectiveness by targeting centrally positioned farmers as information‐diffusion nodes. At the same time, network spillovers may slow adoption of technologies that primarily serve as information‐access tools, rather than speed it up.
abstract_zh: 农业技术采用的实证研究主要聚焦于农户及农场层面的特征，而对采用决策所嵌入的社会背景关注有限。本研究通过考察印度安得拉邦村级社会网络如何影响农民智能手机的采用，填补了这一空白。利用一手调查数据及基于农民报告联系构建的网络度量指标，我们通过平均网络效应（ANE）和度中心性（DC）刻画每位农民的位置。为应对同伴采用的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量（IV）probit模型估计采用行为。与其他农业技术研究结果相反，农民网络联系中智能手机采用率越高，反而降低其自身采用的可能性，这与信息溢出效应一致，即当同伴已采用时，个体私下采用的需求减少。然而，网络中处于更中心位置的农民采用可能性显著更高，这反映了联系广泛个体所承担的更大沟通需求。年龄、社会地位（种姓群体）、家庭规模和土地所有权也是采用的重要相关因素。研究结果表明，农业推广项目可通过瞄准中心位置的农民作为信息传播节点来提高成本效益。同时，网络溢出可能减缓而非加速主要作为信息获取工具的技术的采用。

title: Is Environmentalism the Right Strategy to Decarbonize the World?

title_primary: 环保主义是脱碳世界的正确策略吗？

authors: Marco A. Marini, Ornella Tarola, Jacques-François Thisse
official: 官方在线 2020-10-11 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how the supply of environmentalism, which is defined by psychic benefits (costs) associated with the purchase of high-environmental (low-environmental) qualities, affects the way firms choose their products and the ensuing consequences for the global level of pollution. Contrary to general belief, a high supply of environmentalism does not give rise to a better environmental outcome because it endows firms with more market power which they use to maximize profits. By contrast, standard policy instruments such as a minimum quality standard or the use of greener technologies leads to a better ecological footprint.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了环保主义的供给如何影响企业选择产品的方式及其对全球污染水平的后续影响，其中环保主义被定义为与购买高环保（低环保）质量相关的心理收益（成本）。与普遍认知相反，高环保主义供给并不会带来更好的环境结果，因为它赋予企业更多市场力量，而企业利用这一力量追求利润最大化。相比之下，诸如最低质量标准或采用更绿色技术等标准政策工具则能带来更优的生态足迹。

authors: Panit Wattanakoon
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper analyzes the macroeconomic consequences of bank market power under corporate earnings-based borrowing constraints. By embedding a Cournot banking structure within a Kiyotaki-Moore framework, we uncover a sharp structural reversal: while credit market power dampens the fire-sale multiplier under traditional asset-backed constraints, it amplifies that multiplier under earnings covenants. The endogenous lending markup directly inflates debt-service obligations, tightening borrowers’ cash-flow constraints, forcing deeper asset misallocations and severe aggregate output contractions. Fostering banking competition and relaxing countercyclical covenants act as structural complements, compressing spreads and maximizing real capital retention during financial distress.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在企业盈利为基础的借贷约束下，银行市场势力的宏观经济后果。通过将古诺银行业结构嵌入Kiyotaki-Moore框架，我们揭示了一个显著的结构性反转：在传统资产支持约束下，信贷市场势力抑制了火灾销售乘数，而在盈利契约下则放大了这一乘数。内生贷款加成直接推高了偿债义务，收紧借款人的现金流约束，迫使资产错配加深，并导致严重的总产出收缩。促进银行业竞争与放松逆周期契约在结构上互为补充，压缩利差并在金融困境期间最大化实际资本保留。

title_zh: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？
title_primary: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？
title_secondary: (How) Do Health Shocks Reallocate Research Direction?
authors: Hongyu Zhou, Prashant Garg, Thiemo Fetzer
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine whether research systems reallocate scientific effort as health needs change. We assemble a global disease--location panel for 204 countries and territories (1990--2021) by linking disease-specific publication output to disease burden in the same place and year. Using large language models, we extract diseases from article text, map them into a standardized disease classification, and classify research funders by type. Empirically, we estimate how publication output co-moves with disease burden within countries and diseases over time, and we use event-study difference-in-differences designs that exploit plausibly exogenous variation from the timing of outbreak alerts. We find that responsiveness to endemic burden has increased over time but remains highly uneven across locations; outbreak alerts trigger rapid, statistically significant research surges that have strengthened in recent years; and funding composition is strongly associated with adjustment dynamics, with philanthropic and government-supported research contributing disproportionately to responsiveness growth in lower-income settings.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了研究体系是否随着健康需求的变化而重新配置科研力量。通过将特定疾病的出版产出与同一地点和年份的疾病负担相关联，我们构建了一个覆盖204个国家和地区（1990-2021年）的全球疾病-地点面板数据。利用大型语言模型，我们从文章文本中提取疾病信息，将其映射到标准化的疾病分类中，并按类型对研究资助者进行分类。在实证分析中，我们估计了出版产出如何随国家内部和疾病随时间变化的疾病负担而共同变动，并采用事件研究双重差分设计，利用疫情警报时点的似外生变异。我们发现，对地方性负担的响应性随时间增强，但在不同地点间仍高度不均；疫情警报会触发快速且统计上显著的研究激增，且近年来这种激增有所加强；资助构成与调整动态密切相关，其中慈善和政府支持的研究在低收入环境中的响应性增长中贡献尤为突出。

title: Fiscal Populism and Monetary Policy Rules

title_primary: 财政民粹主义与货币政策规则
title_secondary: Fiscal Populism and Monetary Policy Rules
authors: Mr. Luis Ignacio Jácome & Mr. Nicolas E Magud & Samuel Pienknagura & Martin Uribe
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore the historical link between populist regimes, fiscal monetization, and inflation, and how these links affect monetary policy in the 21st century. Using data for a large set of advanced economies and emerging markets since 1960, we show that, historically, left-leaning populist regimes are linked to increases in central bank lending to the central government, a gauge of deficit monetization. In turn, central bank lending is associated with marked increases in inflation. We show that past exposure to populism that relied on deficit monetization affects the conduct of monetary policy today. Countries with a history of deficit monetization and left-wing populist regimes systematically respond more strongly to deviations of inflation expectations from target. This effect persists even after controlling for the direct effect of past inflation on monetary policy rules. In the context of the literature of experienced learning, this novel finding sheds light on the persistence of past populist policies---central banks operating under the shadow of past populist regimes that relied on inflation-prone deficit monetization continue today needing to send stronger signals of their independence and commitment to price stability to effectively anchor inflation expectations.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了民粹主义政权、财政货币化与通货膨胀之间的历史联系，以及这些联系如何影响21世纪的货币政策。利用自1960年以来涵盖众多发达经济体和新兴市场的数据，我们表明，历史上，左倾民粹主义政权与中央银行对中央政府的贷款增加相关联，这反映了赤字货币化的一个指标。进而，中央银行贷款与通货膨胀的显著上升相关联。我们证明，过去依赖赤字货币化的民粹主义经历会影响当今货币政策的实施。具有赤字货币化和左翼民粹主义政权历史的国家，系统性地对通胀预期偏离目标的情况作出更强烈的反应。即使在控制了过往通胀对货币政策规则的直接影响后，这一效应依然存在。在经验学习的文献背景下，这一新颖发现揭示了过往民粹主义政策的持续性——在依赖易引发通胀的赤字货币化的过往民粹主义政权阴影下运作的中央银行，如今仍需发出更强烈的独立性和对价格稳定承诺的信号，以有效锚定通胀预期。

title: Divided we fall: Differential exposure to geopolitical fragmentation in trade

authors: Shushanik Hakobyan, Sergii Meleshchuk, Robert Zymek
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper assesses differences in countries' macroeconomic exposure to trade fragmentation along geopolitical lines. Estimating structural gravity regressions for sector‐level bilateral trade flows between 185 countries, we find that closer geopolitical ties are associated with lower barriers to trade, with the largest effects concentrated in a few sectors (notably, food and high‐end manufacturing). Consequently, countries' exposure via trade to geopolitical shifts varies with their market size, comparative advantage and foreign policy alignments. Introducing our estimates into a dynamic many‐country, many‐sector quantitative trade model, we show that geoeconomic fragmentation—modelled as an increased sensitivity of trade costs to geopolitics and greater geopolitical polarization—generally leads to lower trade and incomes. However, emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) tend to see the largest impacts: real per‐capita income losses for the median EMDE in Asia are 80% larger, and 120% larger for the median EMDE in Africa, than for the median advanced economy. This suggests that the costs of trade fragmentation could fall disproportionally on countries that can afford it the least.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了各国在宏观经济层面对地缘政治贸易碎片化的暴露程度差异。通过估计涵盖185个国家部门级双边贸易流量的结构引力回归模型，我们发现更紧密的地缘政治联系与更低的贸易壁垒相关联，且最大效应集中在少数几个部门（尤其是食品和高科技制造业）。因此，各国通过贸易对地缘政治变动的暴露程度因其市场规模、比较优势及外交政策取向而异。将我们的估计引入一个动态的多国、多部门量化贸易模型后，我们表明，地缘经济碎片化——建模为贸易成本对地缘政治敏感性的增强及地缘政治极化程度的加深——通常会导致贸易和收入下降。然而，新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）往往受到最大影响：亚洲EMDEs中位数的实际人均收入损失比发达经济体中位数高出80%，非洲EMDEs中位数则高出120%。这表明，贸易碎片化的成本可能不成比例地落在最无力承担的国家身上。

authors: Marc de la Barrera, Masao Fukui
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a theory of firm wage dynamics that integrates the canonical wage-posting model à la Burdett and Mortensen (1998) with firm dynamics. Firms offer dynamic wage contracts under an equal-treatment constraint in the presence of search frictions. We provide an analytical characterization of equilibrium wage contracts and firm growth as functions only of the distribution of marginal surplus. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, the model implies that (i) firm wages are strongly linked to firm growth but not to firm size; (ii) firm wages decline over the firm life cycle; and (iii) the pass-through of permanent productivity shocks to wages is higher in the short run than in the long run. Firms at the top of the job ladder face excessive labor market competition, so the optimal policy subsidizes their hiring. At the macro level, the optimal policy elevates business dynamism in the steady state, and even more so along the transition.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个企业工资动态理论，该理论将经典的Burdett和Mortensen（1998）式工资设定模型与企业动态相结合。在存在搜索摩擦的情况下，企业提供动态工资合同，并受到平等对待约束。我们给出了均衡工资合同和企业增长的解析特征，这些特征仅取决于边际剩余的分布。与近期实证证据一致，该模型表明：（i）企业工资与企业增长紧密相关，但与企业规模无关；（ii）企业工资随企业生命周期下降；（iii）永久性生产率冲击对工资的传导在短期内高于长期。处于工作阶梯顶端的企业面临过度的劳动力市场竞争，因此最优政策补贴其招聘行为。在宏观层面，最优政策提升了稳态下的商业活力，且在转型过程中效果更为显著。

title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal

authors: David Card, Ana Rute Cardoso, Pedro Luis Silva
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In the depths of the 2010 financial crisis the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal data base, merged with information on collective bargaining settlements and firm financial records, to study the impacts of the reforms. We estimate that between 2009 and 2022 average wages of pharmacists fell by a third; most of this reduction was due to lower wages for newly entering cohorts. The implied responsiveness of wages to productivity is substantially above most estimates in the rent-sharing literature, arguably reflecting the strong attachment of workers to the sector and the steady inflow of newly graduating pharmacists. Stepping back, we then consider how wages of pharmacists have diverged relative to wages of other health care professionals in Portugal, and the decisions of recent college applicants to enter the profession.
abstract_zh: 在2010年金融危机的深渊中，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销体系实施了一系列改革。随后的三年里，零售药店中每位药剂师带来的附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代的增加以及处方药允许加价幅度的减少。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师薪资削减，并为新入职者引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有或完全没有放缓。我们利用《员工名册》数据库中的详细纵向记录，结合集体谈判协议信息和企业财务记录，来研究这些改革的影响。我们估计，在2009年至2022年间，药剂师的平均工资下降了三分之一；这一降幅主要归因于新入职群体的较低薪资。工资对生产率的隐含响应度显著高于租金分享文献中的大多数估计值，这大概反映了工人对该行业的强烈依附以及新毕业药剂师的稳定流入。进一步来看，我们考虑了药剂师工资相对于葡萄牙其他医疗保健专业人员工资的差异，以及近期大学申请者选择进入该职业的决策。

title: Winners and Losers: Competition, Creative Destruction, and Labor Income Risk

abstract: Using U.S. administrative data, we find that technology-driven creative destruction in the product market passes through to worker earnings. The passthrough to incumbent worker earnings is both asymmetric and concentrated: profit drops from rival innovations lead to proportionally greater earnings declines and changes in the likelihood of job destruction than profit gains from their own firm’s innovations, while top workers are significantly more exposed than the average worker. We develop an endogenous-growth model with monopsonistic labor markets and worker heterogeneity that replicates this asymmetry and the distribution of earnings risk. In the model, creative destruction exposes high-income workers to concentrated downside risk while increasing upward mobility for lower-income workers, shaping the welfare consequences of innovation policy.
abstract_zh: 利用美国行政数据，我们发现产品市场中技术驱动的创造性破坏会传导至工人收入。这种传导对在职工人收入的影响既不对称又集中：竞争对手创新导致的利润下降，相较于企业自身创新带来的利润增长，会引发更大比例的收入下降及工作毁灭可能性的变化，而顶尖工人相较于普通工人面临的风险显著更高。我们构建了一个包含垄断性劳动力市场与工人异质性的内生增长模型，该模型复现了这种不对称性及收入风险的分布特征。在模型中，创造性破坏使高收入工人面临集中的下行风险，同时提升低收入工人的向上流动性，从而塑造创新政策的福利后果。

abstract: Platform industries have seen a growing wave of mergers and acquisitions in recent times. In this short paper, we investigate ex-post strategies of the monopoly platform business and its impact on user welfare. We develop a model of a duopoly market of E-commerce platforms where a merger is under consideration. This paper analyzes two possible post-merger strategies; a two-platform monopoly and a single-platform monopoly. Our findings suggest that (i) users are better off with a single-platform monopoly when both buyers and sellers singlehome; (ii) when one of the user groups multihomes and the other group singlehomes, a two-platform monopoly can result in a higher user surplus compared to single-platform monopoly if the platforms are highly differentiated. Our results provide useful guidance to policymakers on post-merger strategies of E-commerce platforms.
abstract_zh: 近年来，平台产业并购浪潮日益高涨。本文旨在探讨垄断平台企业的事后策略及其对用户福利的影响。我们构建了一个考虑并购的电子商务平台双头垄断市场模型，并分析了两种可能的事后并购策略：双平台垄断与单平台垄断。研究发现：（i）当买卖双方均选择单一归属时，单平台垄断对用户更为有利；（ii）当一方用户群体多归属而另一方单一归属时，若平台间差异化程度较高，双平台垄断相比单平台垄断能带来更高的用户剩余。我们的研究结果为政策制定者提供了关于电子商务平台并购后策略的有益指导。

title: Endogenous Minimum Participation in International Environmental Treaties
title_zh: 国际环境条约中的内生最低参与度

authors: Carlo Carraro, Carmen Marchiori, Sonia Oreffice
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2011-12-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many international treaties come into force only after a minimum number of countries have signed and ratified the treaty. Why do countries agree to introduce a minimum participation constraint among the rules characterising an international treaty? This question is particularly relevant in the case of environmental treaties dealing with global commons, where free-riding incentives are strong. Is a minimum participation rule a way to offset these free-riding incentives? Why do countries that know they have an incentive to free-ride accept to tie their hands through the introduction of a minimum participation constraint? This paper addresses the above questions by analysing a three-stage non-cooperative coalition formation game. In the first stage, countries set the minimum coalition size that is necessary for the treaty to come into force. In the second stage, countries decide whether to sign the treaty. In the third stage, the equilibrium values of the decision variables are set. At the equilibrium, both the minimum participation constraint and the number of signatories - the coalition size - are determined. This paper shows that a non-trivial partial coalition, sustained by a binding minimum participation constraint, forms at the equilibrium. This paper thus explains why in international negotiations all countries often agree on a minimum participation rule even when some of them do not intend to sign the treaty. The paper also analyses the optimal size of the minimum participation constraint.
abstract_zh: 许多国际条约只有在达到最低签署与批准国家数量后方可生效。为何各国同意在界定国际条约的规则中引入最低参与约束？这一问题在处理全球公共品环境条约时尤为突出——此类条约中"搭便车"动机极为强烈。最低参与规则能否抵消这种搭便车倾向？明知自身存在搭便车动机的国家，为何甘愿通过引入最低参与约束来束缚自身行动？本文通过构建三阶段非合作联盟形成博弈模型，对上述问题展开分析。第一阶段，各国设定条约生效所需的最低联盟规模；第二阶段，各国决定是否签署条约；第三阶段，确定决策变量的均衡值。在均衡状态下，最低参与约束与签署国数量（即联盟规模）同时内生决定。研究表明，均衡中会形成由具有约束力的最低参与约束所支撑的非平凡部分联盟。由此，本文解释了为何在国际谈判中，即便部分国家无意签署条约，所有国家仍常就最低参与规则达成共识。本文还进一步分析了最低参与约束的最优规模。

abstract: This paper studies entrepreneurship and firm creation through the lens of serial entrepreneurs – entrepreneurs who establish more than one firm. Using data covering the universe of Chinese firms, we document key facts about serial and non-serial entrepreneurs and develop a theory rationalizing how their behavior is shaped by ability, endowments, and capital market frictions. Serial entrepreneurs have higher average productivity and lower return on capital than non-serial entrepreneurs. However, this premium conceals significant heterogeneity, with a majority of serial entrepreneurs underperforming relative to non-serial entrepreneurs. We link these differences to capital market frictions favoring some, but not all, entrepreneurs.
abstract_zh: 本文通过连续创业者——即创立多家企业的创业者——的视角研究创业与企业创建。利用覆盖中国全部企业的数据，我们记录了连续创业者与非连续创业者的关键特征，并构建理论阐释能力、禀赋及资本市场摩擦如何塑造其行为。连续创业者的平均生产率高于非连续创业者，但资本回报率却更低。然而，这一优势掩盖了显著的异质性：多数连续创业者的表现不及非连续创业者。我们将这些差异归因于资本市场摩擦对部分创业者（而非全部）的偏向性影响。

abstract: We examine the role of state-dependent distribution frictions in the transmission of monetary policy shocks in a dynamic multi-sector general equilibrium model. Our benchmark model predicts a counter-cyclical distribution margin, which is consistent with micro price evidence. We then estimate an augmented model with price and wage rigidities and attribute the lion’s share of this countercyclicality to service-sector productivity shocks. By allowing for distribution frictions to depend on the state of the economy, which substantially alters monetary transmission, we find that state dependence weakens the real effects of monetary policy by dampening the consumption response to monetary shocks. In stark contrast, such a result cannot be replicated when distribution frictions are time-invariant. Our findings highlight a novel channel through which the interplay between sectoral productivity and distribution frictions jointly influences monetary policy transmission.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了状态依赖型分销摩擦在动态多部门一般均衡模型中对货币政策冲击传导的作用。我们的基准模型预测了一个逆周期的分销利润率，这与微观价格证据相符。随后，我们估计了一个包含价格和工资粘性的扩展模型，并将这种逆周期性的主要部分归因于服务部门的生产率冲击。通过允许分销摩擦依赖于经济状态，这显著改变了货币传导机制，我们发现状态依赖性通过抑制消费对货币冲击的反应，削弱了货币政策的实际效应。与此形成鲜明对比的是，当分销摩擦为时间不变时，无法复制这一结果。我们的发现突显了一个新颖的渠道，通过该渠道，部门生产率与分销摩擦之间的相互作用共同影响货币政策的传导。

abstract: Gene editing (GE) is gaining momentum worldwide, but limited data on UK farmers' preferences hinders our understanding of its potential impact amid deregulation debates. Based on a survey of 200 English arable farmers, we employ a Latent Class Analysis and Multinomial Logit regressions to investigate current preferences for GE crops. The analysis reveals a high willingness of adoption, outlines three preference profiles, including eager, wary, and hesitant adopters, and identify factors influencing such preferences. Results spot a possible substitution effect among GE crops and agricultural insurance, and suggest farmers may adopt GE in response to growing public demand for sustainable practices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 基因编辑技术在全球范围内发展迅速，但关于英国农民偏好的数据有限，这阻碍了我们在放松管制辩论中理解其潜在影响。基于对200名英格兰耕地农民的调查，我们采用潜在类别分析和多项逻辑回归模型，研究当前对基因编辑作物的偏好。分析显示农民采用意愿较高，勾勒出三种偏好类型，包括积极采纳者、谨慎采纳者和犹豫采纳者，并识别出影响这些偏好的因素。结果揭示了基因编辑作物与农业保险之间可能存在的替代效应，并表明农民可能因公众对可持续实践日益增长的需求而采纳基因编辑技术。

abstract: Using multiple administrative data sources from Norway, we examine how firm performance changes after entrepreneurs become parents.Female-owned businesses experience a substantial decline in profits, steadily decreasing to 30% below baseline ten years post-childbirth.In contrast, male-owned businesses show no decline, often growing in revenues and costs after childbirth.The profit decline for female-owned firms is most pronounced among highly capable entrepreneurs, women who are majority owners, and those with working spouses.Entrepreneurial effort is key to performance, and our findings suggest that time demands from childbirth and childcare are a significant determinant of the decline in firm profits.
abstract_zh: 利用挪威的多项行政数据来源，我们考察了企业家成为父母后企业绩效的变化。女性拥有的企业在利润上出现显著下降，产后十年内利润持续下滑至基准水平的30%。相比之下，男性拥有的企业未出现下降，且在产后收入和成本往往有所增长。女性企业利润下降在能力较强的企业家、女性占多数股权的所有者以及配偶有工作的群体中最为明显。创业努力是绩效的关键因素，我们的研究结果表明，生育和育儿的时间需求是导致企业利润下降的重要决定因素。

title: Improving Student Outcomes through Adaptive Learning Platforms: Experimental Evidence from the Dominican Republic
title_zh: 通过自适应学习平台提升学生成绩：来自多米尼加共和国的实验证据

authors: Lopez, Carolina, Pineda, Astrid
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Most students in developing countries receive grade-level instruction despite lacking prerequisite skills, a mismatch that widens learning gaps as students progress. This paper reports evidence from a randomized controlled trial across 38 classrooms and 1,333 ninth-grade students in the Dominican Republic, in which classrooms were randomly assigned to one of three arms: computer-adaptive learning (CAL) software replacing two of seven weekly mathematics hours, CAL combined with small-group tutoring, or a business-as-usual control. CAL improved test scores by 0.29–0.31 standard deviations over six months, among the larger effects documented for education technology interventions in developing countries. Adding small-group tutoring yielded no detectable improvement over CAL alone; if anything, classrooms assigned to both interventions showed smaller gains than those receiving CAL alone, though this difference is not statistically significant. Evidence on mechanisms indicates that tutoring classrooms exhibited reduced engagement with the CAL platform. These results suggest that computer-adaptive learning software can be effectively integrated into classroom instruction to improve learning at scale, but that combining multiple interventions is not guaranteed to produce additive benefits and may instead generate unintended behavioral responses that offset their effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家多数学生虽缺乏必要先修技能，却仍接受年级水平教学，这种不匹配随着学业推进加剧了学习差距。本文基于多米尼加共和国38个班级、1333名九年级学生的随机对照试验证据，将班级随机分配至三组：每周七小时数学课时中两小时替换为计算机自适应学习（CAL）软件、CAL结合小组辅导、或常规教学对照组。六个月后，CAL使测试成绩提升0.29–0.31个标准差，这一效果在发展中国家教育技术干预研究中属于较大效应。相较于单独使用CAL，增加小组辅导未带来可检测的改善；相反，接受双重干预的班级成绩提升幅度甚至低于仅使用CAL的班级，尽管该差异未达统计显著性。机制证据表明，辅导班级学生对CAL平台的参与度有所降低。这些结果表明，计算机自适应学习软件可有效融入课堂教学以实现规模化学习改善，但多重干预的组合未必产生叠加效益，反而可能引发非预期的行为反应，抵消其有效性。

title: Violence and ethnic identity

title_primary: 暴力与族群认同

authors: Elizalde, Aldo, Hidalgo, Eduardo, Kampanelis, Sotiris
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Can violence erase an ethnic identity? We study this question using the Shining Path insurgency in Peru (1980-1992), which sought to replace competing affiliations with a single class identity and killed roughly 70,000 people, three-quarters of them Indigenous. Combining individual-level data on self-identification and mother tongue with event-level data on Shining Path violence, we implement a difference-in-differences design that exploits variation in exposure across cohorts at different stages of identity formation, within a matched border sample of pre-conflict comparable districts. Individuals exposed during their formative years (ages 0-19) are substantially less likely to identify as Indigenous or to speak an Indigenous language than cohorts whose identity was already formed when violence arrived. The effect is concentrated mostly in early childhood and particularly pronounced for mother tongue; the margin most directly shaped by parental transmission. Violence against non-Indigenous victims has no comparable effect. The mechanism is intra-group violence: because perpetrators were overwhelmingly co-ethnics from the same villages, visible Indigenous identity offered no protection and imposed costs. Consistent with this, the effect is strongest in Indigenous-homogeneous districts.
abstract_zh: 暴力能否抹去族群认同？我们以秘鲁"光辉道路"叛乱（1980-1992年）为研究对象，该组织试图以单一阶级认同取代其他身份认同，造成约7万人死亡，其中四分之三为原住民。通过将个体层面的自我认同与母语数据同"光辉道路"暴力事件数据相结合，我们采用双重差分法，利用冲突前可比地区匹配边界样本中不同身份形成阶段队列的暴露差异进行分析。结果表明，在身份形成期（0-19岁）暴露于暴力的个体，其认同为原住民或使用原住民语言的可能性显著低于暴力发生时身份已固化的队列。该效应主要集中在幼儿期，对母语的影响尤为突出——这一维度最直接受父母代际传递影响。针对非原住民受害者的暴力未产生类似效应。其机制在于群体内部暴力：由于施暴者绝大多数来自同村落的同族群体，显性的原住民身份既无法提供保护反而招致代价。与此一致的是，该效应在原住民聚居区最为显著。

title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
title_zh: 人工智能在金融监管中的最优应用
title_primary: 人工智能在金融监管中的最优应用

authors: Christopher Clayton, Antonio Coppola
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构整体数据时，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于火线抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即使将整个资产类别或投资者排除在训练集之外，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化说明这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。

title: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting: The Case of Morocco
title_zh: 利用非传统数据进行宏观经济即时预测：摩洛哥案例
title_primary: 利用非传统数据进行宏观经济即时预测：摩洛哥案例
title_secondary: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting: The Case of Morocco
authors: Dina M Hamed
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Making informed policy decisions is contingent upon the availability of reliable and timely data. The use of non-traditional data has been shown to be a powerful tool for enabling policymakers to conduct robust nowcasting—the practice of estimating the current period’s economic indicator(s), ahead of official releases, using a wide range of macroeconomic and high-frequency data. This paper showcases how different types of non-traditional data, such as indices extracted from satellite imagery, Google Trends, and flight tracking information, can be leveraged to complement official statistics and monitor economic activity, and how these timely signals can be incorporated into nowcasting models to provide early estimates of key macroeconomic variables in Morocco. The approach is applied to agricultural gross value added, tourism revenues, and the unemployment rate. The results demonstrate that non-traditional data substantially improves nowcasting models by enhancing predictive accuracy and enabling the rapid generation of nowcast estimates prior to the release of official data.
abstract_zh: 制定明智的政策决策依赖于可靠且及时的数据。非传统数据的运用已被证明是强有力的工具，能够帮助政策制定者进行稳健的即时预测——即在官方数据发布前，利用广泛的宏观经济和高频数据估算当前时期的经济指标。本文展示了如何利用不同类型的非传统数据（如从卫星图像、谷歌趋势和航班追踪信息中提取的指数）来补充官方统计数据并监测经济活动，以及如何将这些及时信号纳入即时预测模型，为摩洛哥的关键宏观经济变量提供早期估算。该方法应用于农业总增加值、旅游收入和失业率。结果表明，非传统数据通过提高预测准确性，并能够在官方数据发布前快速生成即时预测估算，显著改进了即时预测模型。

title: Elite persistence in family: The role of adoption in prewar Japan
title_zh: 家族中的精英延续：战前日本收养制度的作用
title_primary: 家族中的精英延续：战前日本收养制度的作用
title_secondary: Elite persistence in family: The role of adoption in prewar Japan
authors: Hiroshi Kumanomido, Yutaro Takayasu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Why do elite families often maintain their social and economic status across generations? This paper examines the role of adoption in sustaining elite persistence in prewar Japan. Under the Japanese inheritance system, families without a biological son could adopt an heir to continue the family lineage and transfer assets and social status. Using novel father–heir linked data constructed from the Personnel Inquiry Records (1903–39), we compare elite outcomes between biological and adopted heirs. We find that adopted heirs were substantially more likely to remain elite and to reach the extreme upper tail of the income distribution than biological heirs. The results are robust to family, regional, occupational, and educational controls. Overall, the findings suggest that adoption functioned as an institutional mechanism that expanded the pool of potential successors beyond biological lineage, thereby strengthening intergenerational elite persistence in prewar Japan.
abstract_zh: 为何精英家族常能代际维持其社会经济地位？本文考察了收养制度在战前日本精英持续性中的作用。在日本继承制度下，无亲生儿子的家族可通过收养继承人延续家族血脉并转移资产与社会地位。利用《人事调查记录》（1903-1939年）构建的新型父子关联数据，我们比较了亲生继承人与收养继承人的精英地位结果。研究发现，收养继承人比亲生继承人更可能维持精英地位并进入收入分配的极端顶端。该结果在控制家庭、区域、职业及教育变量后依然稳健。总体而言，研究结果表明，收养作为一种制度机制，将潜在继承人的范围扩展至血缘关系之外，从而强化了战前日本的代际精英持续性。

title: From policy pilots to green transformation: multidimensional evidence of how STF policies impacts the enhancement of urban green competitiveness

authors: Kedi Jing, Baoliu Liu, Haotian Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how science, technology, and finance (STF) policies improve urban green transformation and competitiveness. Utilizing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model, we analyse panel data from 285 Chinese cities spanning the period 2006–2022 to assess the effect and underlying mechanisms of STF policies on urban green competitiveness. Results show that the implementation of STF policies significantly enhances urban green competitiveness, with an average improvement ranging from 8.12% to 9.18%. Our analysis of the underlying mechanisms reveals that this improvement is driven by three key factors: increased financial incentives for research and development, a rise in green patent awards, and improved total factor productivity. These findings demonstrate that STF policies enhance urban green competitiveness both directly and indirectly through innovation and productivity gains. In addition, we highlight the heterogeneity of STF policy effects across regions, city sizes, resource endowments, and city clusters. Our study provides new empirical evidence and policy insights to guide regions in harnessing the combined power of science, technology, and finance to achieve green and sustainable urban development.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了科技金融（STF）政策如何促进城市绿色转型与竞争力提升。利用多期双重差分（DID）模型，我们分析了2006年至2022年间中国285个城市的面板数据，以评估STF政策对城市绿色竞争力的影响及其内在机制。结果显示，STF政策的实施显著增强了城市绿色竞争力，平均提升幅度介于8.12%至9.18%之间。机制分析表明，这一提升主要由三个关键因素驱动：研发财政激励的增加、绿色专利授权的增长以及全要素生产率的提高。这些发现证明，STF政策通过创新与生产率提升，直接及间接地增强了城市绿色竞争力。此外，我们强调了STF政策效应在区域、城市规模、资源禀赋及城市群间的异质性。本研究提供了新的实证证据与政策启示，以指导各地区利用科技、金融的协同力量，实现绿色可持续的城市发展。

title: Parental mental health and the economic preferences of the next generation
title_zh: 父母心理健康与下一代经济偏好
title_primary: 父母心理健康与下一代经济偏好
title_secondary: Parental mental health and the economic preferences of the next generation
authors: Alexander Bertermann, Hannah Schildberg-Hörisch

abstract: This paper provides the first evidence that children’s economic preferences vary systematically with parental mental health. Using experimentally elicited measures of economic preferences from more than 4500 children in Bangladesh, we document that children of parents with indications of mental illness are less prosocial but more patient than their peers with mentally healthy parents. Attitudes towards risk remain unchanged. We discuss potential pathways through which parental mental health may influence the formation of children’s preferences, documenting that children of parents with indication of mental illness assume greater responsibilities within the family, experience less parental involvement, and are exposed to a more adverse home environment.
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了儿童经济偏好随父母心理健康状况系统性变化的证据。利用从孟加拉国超过4500名儿童中通过实验诱导测量的经济偏好数据，我们记录到，与父母心理健康良好的同龄人相比，父母有心理疾病迹象的儿童表现出较少亲社会性但更具耐心。对风险的态度则保持不变。我们探讨了父母心理健康可能影响儿童偏好形成的潜在途径，指出父母有心理疾病迹象的儿童在家庭中承担更多责任，经历较少的父母参与，并暴露于更为不利的家庭环境之中。

title: Rising Tides, Falling Harvests: Examining the Effects of Salinity Intrusion on Paddy Production in Vietnam's Mekong Delta

authors: Huong Nguyen, Bradford Mills, Chi Ta, Shamar L. Stewart
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Rising sea levels and salinity intrusion increasingly threaten rice farming in Vietnam's Mekong Delta. Using a district‐level panel dataset from 2000 to 2020, this study examines the impacts of salinity on Winter–Spring rice yields and acreage and how farmers adapt to salinity risk. A Nerlovian adaptive expectations model is applied to assess how past exposure influences land‐use decisions. Results show that extreme salinity events exert a stronger and more persistent effect on acreage adjustments than year‐to‐year fluctuations, with reductions most pronounced in salinity‐prone and coastal districts. Spatial heterogeneity underscores the need for location‐specific strategies: infrastructure and salt‐tolerant varieties for inland areas, and support for transitions to alternative land uses in highly exposed regions. Evidence of complementarities between rice and aquaculture suggests integrated systems can sustain production under moderate salinity pressure. These findings highlight the importance of tailored interventions to enhance resilience as salinity intrusion intensifies with sea‐level rise.
abstract_zh: 摘要 海平面上升和盐水入侵日益威胁越南湄公河三角洲的水稻种植。利用2000年至2020年区级面板数据，本研究考察了盐度对冬春稻产量及种植面积的影响，以及农民如何适应盐度风险。采用Nerlovian适应性预期模型评估过去暴露如何影响土地利用决策。结果表明，极端盐度事件对种植面积调整的影响比逐年波动更为强烈且持久，其中在易受盐度影响和沿海地区减少最为显著。空间异质性凸显了针对特定地点策略的必要性：在内陆地区推广基础设施和耐盐品种，在高度暴露区域支持向替代土地利用方式转型。水稻与水产养殖之间互补性的证据表明，在中等盐度压力下，综合系统可维持生产。这些发现强调了随着海平面上升导致盐度入侵加剧，采取量身定制的干预措施以增强韧性的重要性。

authors: Vikram Maheshri, Clifford Winston, Yidi Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Has automakers’ use of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADASs) improved automobile safety? We address this question with a first-of-its-kind trim-level dataset of the universe of registered automobiles and accidents in Texas over a 9-year period. We find that ADASs reduce the risk of a motorist getting in any type of accident by 11 to 14 percent and reduce the risk of a motorist getting in a single-vehicle fatal accident by roughly one-third. Our finding that ADASs have improved automobile safety is especially important because it provides early evidence of the benefits of vehicle automation in actual travel environments. Hopefully, it will spur greater interest in the development and widespread adoption of fully autonomous vehicles and in the potential benefits of other transportation technologies using AI.
abstract_zh: 汽车制造商在高级驾驶辅助系统（ADASs）中应用人工智能（AI）是否提升了汽车安全性？我们利用覆盖得克萨斯州9年间所有注册车辆及事故的首个车型级别数据集，对此问题展开研究。研究发现，ADASs使驾驶员发生任何类型事故的风险降低11%至14%，并将单车致命事故的风险降低约三分之一。这一结论尤为重要，因为它首次提供了车辆自动化在实际出行环境中带来益处的早期证据。我们期待该发现能激发对全自动驾驶汽车研发与普及的更大兴趣，并推动对运用AI的其他交通技术潜在效益的深入探索。

title: Harnessing Indonesia's Circular Bioeconomy: Integrating Land, Marine, Forest and Water Resources for Food System Sustainability
title_zh: 利用印度尼西亚的循环生物经济：整合土地、海洋、森林和水资源以实现粮食系统可持续性

authors: Umi Karomah Yaumidin, Atien Priyanti, Muhammad Indra Al Irsyad, Abdul Muis Hasibuan, Didit Okta Pribadi 等
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Circular bioeconomy (CBE) applications in land, marine, water and forest sectors are evolving rapidly to support agriculture and food systems. Their integration into national development agendas can advance inclusive, sustainable economic growth while enhancing social welfare and environmental stewardship. However, existing literature offers limited cross‐sectoral analysis of CBE applications. This study addresses that gap through an integrative review of concepts, theories, strategies and practices related to CBE in the context of sustainable agriculture and food systems. We examine research trends and propose future directions across four resource domains: land, marine, forest and water. Findings indicate a widespread transformation of sectoral waste and by‐products into biochar, organic fertilisers, animal feed, nutritional supplements and other bio‐based products that strengthen food systems. Additional outputs include bioenergy, bioplastics, handicrafts, furniture and paper. Drawing on these insights, we introduce a causal loop diagram illustrating a CBE model that links all four sectors. For Indonesia, leveraging CBE within global networks will require technological innovation, robust policies and cross‐sector collaboration to realise its full potential and align with global sustainability targets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 循环生物经济（CBE）在土地、海洋、水域和森林部门的应用正迅速发展，以支持农业和食品系统。将其纳入国家发展议程可促进包容性、可持续的经济增长，同时提升社会福利和环境管理。然而，现有文献对CBE应用的跨部门分析有限。本研究通过整合性回顾与可持续农业和食品系统相关的CBE概念、理论、策略和实践，填补了这一空白。我们审视研究趋势，并提出涵盖土地、海洋、森林和水域四个资源领域的未来方向。研究结果表明，部门废弃物和副产品正广泛转化为生物炭、有机肥料、动物饲料、营养补充剂及其他增强食品系统的生物基产品。其他产出包括生物能源、生物塑料、手工艺品、家具和纸张。基于这些见解，我们引入了一个因果回路图，展示连接所有四个部门的CBE模型。对于印度尼西亚而言，在全球网络中利用CBE需要技术创新、强有力的政策和跨部门合作，以充分发挥其潜力并与全球可持续目标保持一致。

title: Estimation precision and robust inference in archival research
title_zh: 档案研究中的估计精度与稳健推断
title_primary: 档案研究中的估计精度与稳健推断
title_secondary: Estimation precision and robust inference in archival research
authors: Joachim Gassen, David Veenman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: OLS estimates of linear regression models become imprecise when distributional assumptions about the regression errors are not strictly met. Such situations frequently arise in applied research due to the heavy-tailed distributions of dependent variables. Using simulated data and replication settings, we show how robust regression estimation can produce more policy-relevant inferences by increasing the precision of estimates, improving test power, and tightening confidence intervals. We provide guidance to researchers on when and how to apply robust estimation as alternative to OLS and how to combine robust regression estimators with fixed effects and clustered standard errors. Given the non-random nature of observations typically downweighted by robust regression estimators, we also illustrate the importance of inspecting the robust regression weights and discuss how these weights can provide useful insights about heterogeneity in treatment effects or relations of interest.
abstract_zh: 当回归误差的分布假设未得到严格满足时，线性回归模型的OLS估计会变得不精确。这种情况在应用研究中经常出现，原因在于因变量具有重尾分布。利用模拟数据和复制设定，我们展示了稳健回归估计如何通过提高估计精度、增强检验功效以及收紧置信区间，从而产生更具政策相关性的推断。我们为研究者提供指导，说明何时以及如何将稳健估计作为OLS的替代方法应用，以及如何将稳健回归估计器与固定效应和聚类标准误相结合。鉴于稳健回归估计器通常降权的观测具有非随机性质，我们还阐述了检查稳健回归权重的重要性，并讨论了这些权重如何为处理效应或感兴趣关系的异质性提供有用见解。

abstract: Previous literature suggests that the pass-through of oil price shocks to inflation rates became weaker since the 1970s. I use a time-varying parameter VAR to show that this trend has recently been reversed with headline and core inflation rates responding more sensitive to oil price shocks. Based on a counterfactual analysis, I offer evidence that increasingly important second round effects propagated via inflation expectations play a key role for these dynamics. Finally, I illustrate that oil price shocks in general and this expectation channel more specifically contributed substantially to the recent surge in inflation rates.
abstract_zh: 既有文献表明，自1970年代以来，石油价格冲击向通胀率的传导效应已有所减弱。我采用时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR）证明，这一趋势近期已发生逆转，总体通胀率与核心通胀率对石油价格冲击的反应变得更加敏感。基于反事实分析，我提供的证据表明，通过通胀预期传播的日益重要的第二轮效应在这些动态变化中扮演了关键角色。最后，我阐明石油价格冲击总体上，尤其是这一预期渠道，对近期通胀率的飙升贡献显著。

title: Unintended consequences of sanitation investment: Negative externalities on water quality and health in India

abstract: Developing countries have increased sanitation investment to reduce diarrheal diseases. However, the direct health benefits of latrine construction can be offset by water pollution externalities due to poor treatment of fecal sludge. I estimate these negative externalities of a sanitation policy in India that subsidized the construction of over 100 million latrines. Exploiting geographical variation in soil characteristics and the differential increase in latrine coverage across districts, I find that the policy increases river pollution by 72%. While it reduces diarrheal mortality overall, this positive health effect is two-thirds smaller in areas with lower capacities for treatment of fecal sludge where water pollution externalities are consequently larger.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家已增加卫生设施投资以减少腹泻疾病。然而，厕所建设带来的直接健康效益可能因粪便污泥处理不善所产生的水污染外部性而被抵消。我评估了印度一项补贴超过1亿个厕所建设的卫生政策所带来的这些负面外部性。利用土壤特征的地理差异及各地区厕所覆盖率的不同增长，我发现该政策使河流污染增加了72%。尽管总体上降低了腹泻死亡率，但在粪便污泥处理能力较低、水污染外部性相应较大的地区，这一正面健康效应减少了三分之二。

abstract: This article examines how Chinese local governments respond to competing policy targets during crises, using the COVID-19 epidemic as a quasi-natural experiment. We construct a novel panel dataset covering 278 prefecture-level cities in China to investigate whether city leaders’ promotion incentives – measured by tenure and age – affect their performance in epidemic control and economic development. Employing difference-in-differences and fixed effects regressions, we find no significant variation in epidemic control outcomes across officials with different tenures or ages. However, during the COVID-19 epidemic, cities governed by short-tenure leaders experienced a 0.84% point higher GDP growth rate compared to those led by long-tenure officials. Furthermore, the impact of officials’ promotion incentives on GDP growth was particularly pronounced among older officials, in northern regions, and after the epidemic was brought under control. These results suggest that competing policy targets may generate unintended performance distortions for local officials, particularly among leaders with lower promotion incentives.

abstract: The study investigates the effects of higher education (HE) expansion policy initiated in China in 1999 on individuals’ engagement with risky financial assets. Utilizing a regression discontinuity (RD) design, the analysis reveals a consistent and statistically significant positive relationship between the HE expansion and the likelihood of investing in risky financial assets. The results indicate that the HE expansion policy increases the propensity to invest in such assets by 2.6% points, representing a 37.1% increase relative to the control group’s mean. The study also conducts robustness tests, including bandwidth sensitivity and placebo tests, to reinforce the reliability of these findings. Mechanism analysis identifies increased income, enhanced cognitive ability, and improved access to financial information as key pathways through which higher education fosters greater participation in risky asset markets. This research contributes to the literature by providing new insights into how educational policies can influence financial behaviours in emerging economies.
